requirements.quote: This document defines version 1 of QUIC, which conforms to the version-independent properties of QUIC defined in [QUIC-INVARIANTS].
requirements.required_behavior: Conform to the version-independent properties of QUIC.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's version-independent packet and protocol properties can be compared with the required QUIC invariants.

requirements.quote: QUIC is a connection-oriented protocol that creates a stateful interaction between a client and server.
requirements.condition: When a client and server communicate using QUIC
requirements.required_behavior: Maintain their interaction as a connection with associated state.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can verify that communication is organized around connection state maintained between client and server.

requirements.quote: The QUIC handshake combines negotiation of cryptographic and transport parameters.
requirements.required_behavior: Negotiate both cryptographic parameters and transport parameters.
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake messages and resulting endpoint state can be inspected for negotiation of both parameter classes.

requirements.quote: QUIC integrates the TLS handshake [TLS13], although using a customized framing for protecting packets.
requirements.condition: When performing a QUIC handshake and protecting QUIC packets
requirements.required_behavior: Integrate the TLS handshake using QUIC's customized framing.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation's handshake integration and packet-protection framing can be inspected or exercised.

requirements.quote: This includes an option for clients to send data immediately (0-RTT), which requires some form of prior communication or configuration to enable.
requirements.condition: When a client sends application data immediately using 0-RTT
requirements.required_behavior: Enable 0-RTT only on the basis of prior communication or configuration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Enable or send 0-RTT data without prior communication or configuration.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can attempt 0-RTT with and without previously established communication or configuration and observe whether it is enabled.

requirements.quote: Endpoints communicate in QUIC by exchanging QUIC packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Wire output can be inspected to verify that endpoint communication is encoded as QUIC packets.

requirements.quote: Most packets contain frames, which carry control information and application data between endpoints.
requirements.condition: When control information or application data is carried between QUIC endpoints
requirements.required_behavior: Carry that information or data in frames contained in packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet contents can be decoded to verify that frames carry control information and application data.

requirements.quote: QUIC authenticates the entirety of each packet
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leave any portion of the packet outside the protocol's authentication coverage.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet protection code and mutation tests can verify authentication coverage across every part of a packet.

requirements.quote: encrypts as much of each packet as is practical.
requirements.required_behavior: Encrypt as much of the packet as is practical.
requirements.why_checkable: The phrase 'as is practical' does not identify a precise encryption boundary within this chunk, so a definitive implementation verdict cannot be derived.

requirements.quote: QUIC packets are carried in UDP datagrams [UDP]
requirements.condition: When transmitting QUIC packets over the network
requirements.required_behavior: Carry QUIC packets in UDP datagrams.
requirements.why_checkable: Network traffic can be inspected to verify that QUIC packets are encapsulated in UDP datagrams.

requirements.quote: Application protocols exchange information over a QUIC connection via streams, which are ordered sequences of bytes.
requirements.condition: When an application protocol exchanges information over a QUIC connection
requirements.required_behavior: Exchange the information through streams represented as ordered byte sequences.
requirements.why_checkable: Stream APIs and received data can be tested to verify byte-sequence ordering.

requirements.quote: Two types of streams can be created: bidirectional streams, which allow both endpoints to send data; and unidirectional streams, which allow a single endpoint to send data.
requirements.required_behavior: Create either a bidirectional stream or a unidirectional stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Create a stream type outside these two types.
requirements.why_checkable: Stream creation APIs and stream-type encodings can be enumerated to verify that exactly these two categories are supported.

requirements.quote: bidirectional streams, which allow both endpoints to send data
requirements.required_behavior: Allow both endpoints to send data on the stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Restrict sending on the stream to only one endpoint.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can attempt transmission by each endpoint on the same bidirectional stream.

requirements.quote: unidirectional streams, which allow a single endpoint to send data.
requirements.required_behavior: Allow only one endpoint to send data on the stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Allow both endpoints to send data on the stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can verify that only the stream's sending endpoint can transmit data.

requirements.quote: A credit-based scheme is used to limit stream creation and to bound the amount of data that can be sent.
requirements.condition: When creating streams or sending data
requirements.required_behavior: Apply credit-based limits to stream creation and to the amount of data that can be sent.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Permit stream creation or data transmission beyond the available credit.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can exhaust advertised credit and verify that additional streams or data are not permitted until more credit is available.

requirements.quote: QUIC depends on congestion control to avoid network congestion.
requirements.required_behavior: Apply congestion control to avoid network congestion.
requirements.why_checkable: Transmission behavior and congestion-control state can be inspected under constrained network conditions.

requirements.quote: Only clients are able to migrate in this version of QUIC.
requirements.condition: When connection migration is attempted in QUIC version 1
requirements.required_behavior: Allow migration when initiated by a client.
requirements.why_checkable: Runtime tests can attempt path migration independently from the client and server and compare the accepted behavior.
